All three overlaps are fixed and shipped as v32.84 (0e5e7ffe). I did not run the critic on the new pictures.

- **One card:** a pad now shows only the focused cell's card. The belt card is off while a pad is driving.
- **Card placement:** the card sat 86 px over the panel because it was placed using a guessed 352 px width instead of its real 440 px. It now sits beside the panel, level with its top, and no longer covers "view to close" or the footer hint. If there is no room beside the panel, it falls back to inside the right edge, below the header and above the hint.
- **Keyboard tag:** the "keyboard" tag now sits top centre in the Undercroft, clear of the location title. This is the only visible change outside the backpack, since the same tag appears in the Undercroft on any screen.

The preflight and the gate passed (seed 4242 fingerprint unchanged at 85/374 and 165/593). The new check uses a stub pad in the hub with the backpack open, at 1080p and 4K. It covers one visible card, the card clear of the header and footer, and the tag clear of the title. The gate ran it twice, and preflight and the ship both passed, so it failed on the build before.

The after pictures from both recipes are in `tools/handoff/console/notes/shots/48-after/`. In the player 1 and player 2 pictures there is a single auto rifle card to the right of the panel, with the header and footer hint fully readable. Player 2 shows the tag centred at the top. I added a line to `notes/ui/changes.md`.

TASK DONE
